d:
Based on the work of the scientist and writer, famous traveler and explorer of the Far East
V. Arseniev. The story of his friendship with the guide Dersu Uzala with extraordinary personal qualities. Their journey through the taiga-forest, full of dangerous adventures, is the plot of the film, but the meaning of the story goes far beyond the plot: it's a story about the brotherhood of people, that we are all children of the same land.
IMDb rating: 8,2
Year of production: 1975
Directed by: Kurosawa Akira
Screenwriters: Yuri Nagibin, Akira Kurosawa
Composer: Schwartz Isaac
